__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Prometheus data source that scrapes the kube-tower metrics

title: kube-tower
description: Versions, release ages, vulnerabilities and security of container images and Helm charts across Kubernetes clusters (kube-tower exporter)

panels.title: Outdated images
panels.description: Distinct images (registry/repository:tag) with a newer version, in the selected clusters

targets.expr: count(kube_tower_image_outdated == 1 and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Image minor/patch
panels.description: A newer minor or patch release of their major version: the safe update

targets.expr: count(kube_tower_image_update_available{update="minor"} == 1 and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"})) or vector(0)

count((kube_tower_image_outdated == 1 and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"})) and on (image, tag) kube_tower_image_outdated{update="major"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Outdated charts
panels.description: ArgoCD Applications whose chart or one of its subcharts has a newer version

panels.title: Critical CVEs
panels.description: Distinct images with at least one critical vulnerability, in the selected clusters

targets.expr: count(kube_tower_image_vulnerabilities{severity="critical"} > 0 and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Last scan
panels.description: Time since the end of the last scan

targets.expr: count by (status) (kube_tower_image_outdated and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"}))
count by (update) (kube_tower_image_outdated == 1 and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"}))

count by (cluster) (group by (cluster, image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"}) and on (image, tag) kube_tower_image_outdated == 1)

panels.title: Updates available: minor/patch or major
panels.description: An image or a chart can have both: behind in its own major version, and a newer major version published

targets.expr: count(kube_tower_image_update_available{update="minor"} == 1 and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"})) or vector(0)

count(kube_tower_image_update_available{update="major"} == 1 and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Release age of the running image versions
panels.description: Images by the age of the release they run (green under 6 months, yellow under a year, orange under 2 years, red beyond)

targets.expr: count((kube_tower_image_release_age_days{release="current"} and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"})) < 180) or vector(0)

count((kube_tower_image_release_age_days{release="current"} and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"})) >= 180 < 365) or vector(0)

count((kube_tower_image_release_age_days{release="current"} and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"})) >= 365 < 730) or vector(0)

count((kube_tower_image_release_age_days{release="current"} and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"})) >= 730) or vector(0)

panels.title: Release age of the newest image releases
panels.description: Images by the age of their newest release: an old newest release may mean an unmaintained image

targets.expr: count((min by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_release_age_days{release=~"latest_.*"}) and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"})) < 180) or vector(0)

count((min by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_release_age_days{release=~"latest_.*"}) and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"})) >= 180 < 365) or vector(0)

count((min by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_release_age_days{release=~"latest_.*"}) and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"})) >= 365 < 730) or vector(0)

count((min by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_release_age_days{release=~"latest_.*"}) and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"})) >= 730) or vector(0)

panels.title: Release age of the deployed chart versions
panels.description: Helm charts by the age of the version deployed

targets.expr: count(kube_tower_image_outdated == 1 and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"}))

panels.title: Minor/patch and major updates over time

targets.expr: count(kube_tower_image_update_available{update="minor"} == 1 and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"}))

count(kube_tower_image_update_available{update="major"} == 1 and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"}))

panels.title: High CVE images
panels.description: Distinct images with at least one high vulnerability, in the selected clusters

targets.expr: count(kube_tower_image_vulnerabilities{severity="high"} > 0 and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Fixable crit./high
panels.description: Critical and high vulnerabilities fixed in a newer version of the package (all images of the selected clusters)

targets.expr: sum(kube_tower_image_vulnerabilities_fixable{severity=~"critical|high"} and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: End of life OS
panels.description: Images whose OS release no longer gets security fixes

targets.expr: count(kube_tower_image_os_eosl == 1 and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Failed scans
panels.description: Images whose vulnerability scan failed (see the kube-tower logs or the Images page)

targets.expr: count(kube_tower_image_vulnerability_scan_failed == 1 and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Last CVE scan
panels.description: Time since the end of the last vulnerability scan

panels.title: Platform CVEs
panels.description: Critical and high vulnerabilities of the Kubernetes and containerd versions run by the clusters (OSV)

panels.title: Vulnerabilities by severity
panels.description: Vulnerabilities of all the images of the selected clusters (an image counts once, whatever the number of clusters)

targets.expr: sum by (severity) (kube_tower_image_vulnerabilities and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"}))
sum by (severity) (kube_tower_image_vulnerabilities and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"}))

panels.title: Kubernetes and containerd vulnerabilities
panels.description: Known vulnerabilities of the versions run by the clusters (OSV)

panels.title: Critical findings
panels.description: Failed checks and exposed secrets of the Trivy Operator security reports

panels.title: Compliance passed
panels.description: Over every compliance framework (CIS, NSA, PSS...)

panels.title: Compliance by framework
panels.description: Share of the controls passed

panels.title: Scan errors
panels.description: Non fatal collection errors of the last scan (e.g. a resource kube-tower is not allowed to list): see the Status page

panels.title: K8s end of life (days)
panels.description: Days until the first end of life of the Kubernetes releases of the clusters (negative once passed)

panels.title: Deprecated APIs
panels.description: Deprecated APIs still requested that a coming Kubernetes release removes

panels.title: Kubernetes end of life by cluster (days)
Scans
panels.description: Scans in the last 6 hours, by result

panels.title: Containers by fit
panels.description: Fit of the requests and limits of the containers analysed by krr

panels.title: Outdated images
panels.description: One line per image: an image used in several clusters is listed once

targets.expr: kube_tower_image_outdated == 1 and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"})

panels.title: Minor/patch and major updates of the images
panels.description: One line per image and kind of update: an image behind in its own major version with a newer major version has two

targets.expr: kube_tower_image_update_available == 1 and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"})

panels.title: Release age of the images
panels.description: Days since the release of the current version, of the latest minor/patch release and of the latest major release

targets.expr: kube_tower_image_release_age_days and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"})

panels.title: Helm charts
panels.description: status is the worst status of the chart and its subcharts

panels.title: Minor/patch and major updates of the charts
Release age of the charts
panels.description: Days since the release of the deployed version, of the latest minor/patch release and of the latest major release

panels.title: Most vulnerable images
panels.description: Vulnerabilities per image and severity, the most critical first; fixable: fixed in a newer version of the package

targets.expr: sum by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_vulnerabilities{severity="critical"} and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"}))

sum by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_vulnerabilities{severity="high"} and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"}))

sum by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_vulnerabilities{severity="medium"} and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"}))

sum by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_vulnerabilities{severity="low"} and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"}))

sum by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_vulnerabilities{severity="unknown"} and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"}))

sum by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_vulnerabilities_fixable and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"}))

panels.title: Workloads running an image with critical vulnerabilities
Findings by namespace
panels.description: Failed checks and exposed secrets of the Trivy Operator reports

panels.title: Node groups
panels.description: Nodes by role, node group, kubelet version and readiness

panels.title: Deprecated APIs requested
panels.description: Requested since the API server started; removed_release: the Kubernetes release that removes them

panels.title: Images present on nodes
panels.description: Images in node.status.images, with the number of nodes holding them

panels.title: CPU and memory requests (krr)
panels.description: Current and recommended requests of each container

targets.expr: max without (__name__, resource) (kube_tower_resources_current{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", type="request", resource="cpu"})
max without (__name__, resource) (kube_tower_resources_recommended{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", type="request", resource="cpu"})
max without (__name__, resource) (kube_tower_resources_current{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", type="request", resource="memory"})
max without (__name__, resource) (kube_tower_resources_recommended{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", type="request", resource="memory"})
